newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Banking sector boosts Moroccan stock exchange.
newsitem.headline: Banking sector boosts Moroccan stock exchange.

text.p: The Casablanca stock exchange rose 0.16 percent on Thursday, lifted mainly by the banking sector, including Wafabank, brokers said.
The all-share index closed at 437.97 points, from 437.25 on Tuesday.
The bourse was closed on Wednesday due to a public holiday.
"The market consolidated its upward trend due largely to banks active trading and other blue chip companies," a trader said.
Wafabank, one the most liquid stocks, gained six dirhams in one session to close at 546 dirhams.
Speculation on the market predicts the bank will increase its capital as it planned to expand its branches throughout the country, the analyst said.
Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur, one of the market's largest capitalisation, rose four dirhams to close at 405 dirhams.
